companyDescription: Lunar & space infrastructure · Nova-C landers (IM-1/IM-2 flown, IM-3 ~early 2027), NASA Near Space Network data relay, Lanteris + Goonhilly acquisitions · Q3 2026 revenue $269M, positive FCF, $1.87B backlog
priceNote: Live $9.75 (+11.1%) on the Nov 23 relief rally (live-prices cache). Still ~79% below the $45.70 52-week high, ~49% below its 200-day (~$19.08) and within 13% of the 52-week low ($8.62). The stock fell 27% in October alone despite record Q3 numbers.
summary: A space name priced like it is in trouble, though it is not: Q3 2026 revenue was $269M (vs ~$248M est.), adjusted EBITDA +$8.3M, free cash flow +$33.5M, cash $463.8M and backlog $1.87B, with FY26 revenue guidance of $920–950M reaffirmed. Yet the stock is ~$9.75, ~79% off its high, after the November speculative-tech crash. There is no near-term binary event; the catalysts are the Q4 print (~Mar 2027) and IM-3 (NASA lists early 2027). Base +60% is a 6–12 month re-rating toward the 200-day, so it sits above the turbo P75 (21.5%) by design. Survival is the strongest on this list. แนะนำ 2% ของ portfolio เท่านั้น (macro WAIT) — ถ้า thesis fail ลงได้ 40–50%.

catalysts.name: Q4 2026 results / FY27 guide
catalysts.description: First full-year print with Lanteris consolidated. The FY26 $920–950M revenue guide and positive adjusted EBITDA were reaffirmed at Q3; a FY27 guide that converts the $1.87B backlog is the re-rating trigger. No date announced.

catalysts.name: IM-3 lunar landing mission (Reiner Gamma)
catalysts.description: Third Nova-C mission on a Falcon 9. NASA's CLPS schedule lists it as early 2027; older trackers said H2 2026, so treat the date as fuzzy. A clean landing after IM-1 and IM-2 both tipped over would be the binary narrative win.

risks: Lunar landing execution: IM-1 (Feb 2024) and IM-2 both landed tipped over. A third failed landing on IM-3 would hit credibility on NASA CLPS follow-ons.
Contract concentration: NASA picked Astrolab and Lunar Outpost over Intuitive Machines for the Lunar Terrain Vehicle award (May 2026). Government budget/award timing drives the backlog.

Operating loss widened to $34.2M in Q3 even as adjusted EBITDA turned positive — acquisition integration (Lanteris, Goonhilly) adds execution risk; one summary headlined 'contract cuts', which could not be verified.
Analyst targets are stale (Canaccord $41 and KeyBanc $27 are from spring 2026); no November 2026 target changes were found.
Macro WAIT (15/100): high-beta space names fell 50–80% in the Nov selloff and have no floor until the S&P reclaims its 200-day.

macroRisk.rateOutlook: Fed funds 3.75–4.00%. CME FedWatch prices a +25bp hike at the Dec 9 FOMC at ~91% (Nov 23); futures dropped the 50bp tail after the November selloff.
macroRisk.inflationNote: Oct core CPI +0.3% m/m (hot). Sep core PCE 3.1% y/y; Oct PCE (Nov 25) consensus 3.2% is the last inflation print before the Fed.
macroRisk.sectorImpact: Space infrastructure is a long-duration, high-beta growth trade: rate hikes and a risk-off tape compress multiples hardest here, even with positive FCF.
macroRisk.summary: HIGH — /macro is WAIT (15/100, high conviction): S&P 7,237 is still below its 200-day (~7,340) after the Nov 23 +4.7% squeeze, VIX 27, breadth ~43% above 50DMA, HY OAS widening to ~3.52%. Turbo prior is unproven in this regime (0/107 windows had SPY down >2%).
